clue.text: Justification for land that goes with house

definitions.meaning: a reason or basis offered for doing something, as in cause for complaint
the gardens and estate surrounding a large residence

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a basis or cause for action and the estate around a mansion.

clue.text: Stalin as a crazy aggressor

indicators.note: something crazy is wild and disordered, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Stalin, mad as he was, is called a warlike aggressor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazy' signals the anagram; the lone 'a' from the end of the clue lands at the front of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An aggressor is one who attacks, the same as an attacker or assailant in plain speech.

clue.text: Charlie is covering one in place of Francis

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces sit on top of, and so cover, the piece below

parts.note: a charlie is British slang for a fool or idiot, as is an ass
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A fool is shielding someone in the place associated with Saint Francis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' works because this is a down entry: ASS and IS are written above I. A 'charlie' is British slang for a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Francis is named after the Umbrian hill town where he was born and founded his order.

clue.text: One who assists with lateral pass in football?

parts.note: lateral means to the side
a pass made with the foot in soccer is a kick

explanation.surface: A footballer's helpful sideways ball defines the teammate who sets up the goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidekick is a close companion or assistant, the helper who backs up the hero.

clue.text: Great treatment! In dose, every germ destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed means smashed up, so these letters are broken apart and rebuilt in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A doctor cheers a medicine that wipes out every germ in a single dose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroyed' signals an anagram of IN DOSE EVERY GERM, fifteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A sovereign remedy is an old phrase for a supremely effective cure, a panacea.

clue.text: Businessman — the guy who makes decisions about cuts

definitions.meaning: a board member running a company

definitions.text: the guy who makes decisions about cuts
definitions.meaning: a film-maker who calls 'cut' and chooses which takes are edited out

explanation.definitionFit: The title fits both a company board member and the person in charge of shooting a film, who calls for and decides on cuts.

clue.text: Form of oriental fighting getting encouragement from Barbie?

parts.note: Barbie the doll's boyfriend is the doll Ken, so he comes from Barbie's world
'Do!' is an urging word, a spur to go ahead

explanation.surface: A doll is spurred on to take up martial arts.
explanation.walkthrough: Barbie stands for her famous companion doll Ken; 'Do!' is a cry urging someone on.
explanation.definitionFit: Kendo is the Japanese martial art of fencing with bamboo swords.

clue.text: Accountant not as outgoing as bank worker

parts.note: CA is short for Chartered Accountant
someone less outgoing is more timid, that is, shier

explanation.surface: An accountant who is more reserved than a teller at the bank.
explanation.walkthrough: CA stands for Chartered Accountant, a British professional qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: A cashier handles cash at the counter of a bank, the teller.

clue.text: Constant increases producing very difficult times

parts.note: c is the symbol for a constant in maths and physics (the speed of light)
goes up, climbs

explanation.surface: Ever-rising prices bring on hard times.
explanation.definitionFit: Crises are moments of acute danger or trouble.

clue.text: Poetry about an artist from Italian city

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the poetry word wraps around the other

parts.note: poetry is verse
an means one, a single

explanation.surface: A verse is written about a painter from an Italian town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals a container. The word also means a native of Verona, which the painter was named after.
explanation.definitionFit: Paolo Veronese was a Renaissance painter, named after Verona, and the word also means a native of that city.

clue.text: Medicine provided by clergyman about four

indicators.note: about means around, so the clergyman wraps the numeral

parts.note: a curate is an assistant parish priest
the Roman numeral for four is IV

explanation.surface: A vicar's assistant hands out some medicine for four people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal, not a vague link; 'provided by' only joins definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, a curative is a remedy or drug that heals.

clue.text: Composer of dance in major key, initially

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the key letter goes in front of the rest

parts.note: C major is the best-known major key, so C stands for it
a hop is an informal dance

explanation.surface: Asks for a composer of a dance in a major key.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'dance in' as HOP IN, with 'major key' (C) placed first because of 'initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: Frederic Chopin was the Polish Romantic composer of piano works.

clue.text: Girl's capital in 14

definitions.meaning: the chief city of a state in the continent answered at 14

explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', linking the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female first name and the capital city of South Australia.

clue.text: Dilatory reforms believed in by nobody in good faith?

definitions.text: believed in by nobody in good faith?

indicators.note: reforms means remakes or reshapes, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Slow worship practices are reformed, though no true believer accepts them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reforms' signals an anagram of DILATORY. The definition is cryptic: worship of false gods is something no sincere believer holds to.
explanation.definitionFit: Worshipping images or false gods is condemned by every true faith, so no real believer embraces it.

clue.text: Gore in part of Europe, or another continent

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the name goes within the country

parts.note: Austria is a European country
Al Gore, former US vice-president

explanation.surface: A politician turns up in Europe or on some other continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gore' looks like blood or a triangle of cloth; it is the former US vice-president. 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Australia is a continent as well as a country, distinct from Europe.

clue.text: Reduce formal agreement between parties

definitions.meaning: to shrink or become smaller (a verb)

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to shrink or tighten; as a noun it is a binding legal deal.

clue.text: Source of white blossom, as American author said

indicators.note: said means spoken, so the author's name heard out loud gives the entry

parts.note: Nathaniel Hawthorne wrote The Scarlet Letter

explanation.surface: A white-flowering shrub, as an American writer might mention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' shows the name of the American writer Nathaniel Hawthorne is heard, not seen; drop his final E.
explanation.definitionFit: The hawthorn, or may tree, is a hedgerow shrub covered in white flowers in spring.

clue.text: Everything being included, implying end of story?

definitions.meaning: when a tale has been completely recounted there is nothing left to say

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means 'in total', and read literally it describes a story recounted to the very end.

clue.text: Artist with musical instrument getting reduced fare from Italy

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the instrument loses its final letter

parts.note: the violin is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A painter with his fiddle shortened gets an Italian meal.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, a Royal Academician, is the stock crossword artist. 'getting reduced' cuts the N off VIOLIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli are small stuffed pasta parcels, a classic Italian dish.

clue.text: Counter-argument that's genuine about central target

indicators.note: the first word wraps around the target, which sits in its centre

parts.note: genuine means real
a butt is a target, as on a shooting range or the butt of a joke

explanation.surface: A real rebuttal hits the bullseye, the centre of the argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about central' says the target word sits right in the middle of the genuine word, splitting it into two equal halves.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuttal is a refutation, a reply contradicting an opponent's case.

clue.text: Alter into suit

definitions.meaning: change and turn into something else
flatter or look good on, as a hat suits you

explanation.definitionFit: It means to turn into something and also to flatter or look good on someone.

clue.text: New bowler, for example, is not so stale

definitions.text: New bowler, for example, is not so stale

parts.words: New bowler, for example, is not so stale
parts.note: a freshly bought bowler is no worn hat from long ago, and the phrase for such a worn item also means tired and out of date

explanation.walkthrough: 'bowler' suggests cricket; here it is the hat, and a new one is the opposite of the stale phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hackneyed or out of fashion is called this, from the image of a battered headpiece.

clue.text: Man will ring — and hear this?

definitions.text: Man will ring — and hear this?

parts.note: HE'LL is the short form of 'he will'
a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: A man will make a phone call and you will hear him greet you.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: when a man rings you hear his greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: The usual greeting on picking up a phone call is this word.

clue.text: Snake seen on Indian's foot

definitions.meaning: a venomous pit viper of the southern US, the water snake known as a cottonmouth
a soft leather shoe worn by Native Americans

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a venomous American pit viper and the soft leather slipper of Native Americans.

clue.text: Ideal partner providing what sounds like only way to end game

indicators.note: the words signal that the pieces are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: sole means only, single; checkmate, or mate, ends a game of chess

explanation.surface: A perfect match sounds like the only way to finish a chess game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'what sounds like' marks SOLE MATE as heard; mate is the move that ends chess.
explanation.definitionFit: A soulmate is a person perfectly suited to another, an ideal companion.

clue.text: Courageous about current, most of the time

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the bravery word wraps the current symbol

parts.note: manly means brave, courageous
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A brave swimmer fighting the current, most of the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Mainly means largely or for the most part.

clue.text: With skill, converted from 13

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so those letters are rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 13 across, read as letters

explanation.surface: A neat conversion from false worship, done with skill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' signals an anagram of the answer at 13.
explanation.definitionFit: Adroitly means deftly or cleverly, done with dexterity.
